user.title: Ajouter un compte
user.description: Sign in with your account and password, then choose vehicle features. Your password is not saved in integration configuration.

reauth_confirm.title: Ninebot
reauth_confirm.description: The password is used only for this login and is not stored in integration configuration.

reconfigure.title: Ninebot
reconfigure.description: The password is used only for this login and is not stored in integration configuration.

sms_account.title: Send login code
sms_account.description: Submitting sends one SMS; delivery is never retried automatically.

sms_code.title: SMS login
sms_code.description: Enter the code or explicitly resend. Local resend cooldown is 60 seconds; this flow is cleaned up after 10 minutes. These are not upstream validity guarantees.

features.title: Vehicle features
features.description: Account verified. Choose vehicle features; rated voltage and capacity can be entered on the device page after setup.

data_description.enable_estimation: Set rated battery parameters, including voltage and capacity.
data_description.enable_coordinates: Show vehicle location on maps and use it in zones.
data_description.debug_mode: Show a bounded parsed view of current data. Use the integration menu to enable debug logging and download logs and diagnostics.

error.upstream_error: Ninebot service returned an error; try later
error.unsupported_platform: The vehicle connection service cannot run on this platform.
error.busy: Session is busy; try again later
error.storage_error: Cannot save session; check storage and permissions
error.password_required: Enter a password or choose SMS login.
error.invalid_account: SMS login currently requires an 11-digit mainland China mobile number.
error.sms_cooldown: Wait for the local 60-second cooldown before explicitly sending again.

abort.session_update_failed: Session update failed and the previous session was restored. Start reauthentication again.
abort.session_recovery_pending: Session recovery is pending and backups are retained. Review the Repair issue and restart HA before retrying.
abort.sms_expired: The SMS login flow expired. Start again.
abort.storage_error: Local session storage failed. Check storage and try again.
abort.sms_unavailable: SMS sign-in is unavailable. Use your password.
abort.onboarding_expired: Feature setup expired. Add the account again.

init.title: Options
init.description: Choose vehicle features and history synchronization, and enable remote controls if needed. Rated battery parameters are specifications, not measured capacity.

data_description.debug_mode: Show a bounded parsed view of current data. Use the integration menu to enable debug logging and download logs and diagnostics.
data_description.configure_model: Set rated battery parameters, including voltage and capacity.
data_description.enable_coordinates: Show vehicle location on maps and use it in zones.
data_description.enable_calendar: Show a local ride calendar for each vehicle. Turning it off preserves recorded history and entity identity. Browsing does not query the cloud.
data_description.preserve_history: Save available trip details and tracks locally; after the initial scan, fetch missing or updated records incrementally.
data_description.history_requests_per_hour: Shared account limit for background month and detail queries. Transport retries are separate from this logical operation counter.
data_description.auto_history_sync: Découvrir l’historique disponible de tous les véhicules du compte, puis synchroniser les changements.
data_description.history_storage_mib: 32–2048 MiB par compte, 100 par défaut. Réduire la limite conserve les données et peut suspendre les écritures.

model_parameters.title: Configurer les valeurs nominales
model_parameters.description: Enter rated voltage and capacity. Changes update the same entity; these are not measured capacity or battery health.

abort.model_unavailable: Load the integration and choose a current vehicle before configuring rated parameters.

model_storage_invalid.message: Battery parameter storage is unavailable. Resolve the Repair before saving.

invalid_auth.message: The session is invalid; reauthenticate through Devices & services.

query_unavailable.message: Vehicle query unavailable: ensure the integration is loaded, the session is valid and the vehicle remains in a fresh account vehicle list.

query_device.message: Select one unambiguous Ninebot vehicle device belonging to this integration.

query_coordinates.message: Enable coordinates in integration options before requesting a trip track.

query_detail_limit.message: When including details, set the page size to five or less.

query_ride.message: No unique verified trip detail ID is available for this vehicle and month.

history_range.message: Choose an ordered month range of at most 360 months.

history_cursor.message: The continuation expired, was evicted, or belongs to another vehicle/range. Start again.

statistics_range.message: Select a range of one to six months with the start no later than the end.

statistics_recorder.message: Recorder must be running to import native statistics. Period query Actions still work without it.

statistics_timezone.message: Native period charts currently require the Home Assistant time zone Asia/Shanghai. Query responses remain available in other time zones.

statistics_import_data.message: Existing statistics have incompatible units, shape or period values, or exceed the import budget. Nothing in this batch was queued. Review the statistics before retrying.

entity_id_storage_invalid.message: Entity identity storage unavailable; check Repairs.

control_target_not_observed.message: Not confirmed within 10 seconds. Check the vehicle state.

control_not_sent.message: Commande non envoyée : la communication est temporairement indisponible. Réessayez plus tard.

sync_job.message: Aucune tâche correspondante pour ce véhicule et cet identifiant.

calendar_range.message: Choisissez une période plus courte : au maximum cinq ans et 5 000 trajets enregistrés.

calendar_unavailable.message: Les archives locales des trajets sont temporairement indisponibles. Réessayez dans un instant.

recorded_range.message: Choisir jusqu’à cinq ans, dans l’ordre chronologique. Réduire la période si la limite de lecture est dépassée.

query_detail_not_recorded.message: This trip detail is not saved locally. Fetch its cloud detail separately before viewing the track.

query_local_refresh.message: Local-only reading cannot be combined with cloud refresh.

history_object_corrupt.message: Certaines données locales ont échoué à la vérification

entity_identity_conflict.title: Duplicate legacy entity identities
entity_identity_conflict.description: Multiple legacy entities represent the same function. Their identities and history are preserved; equivalent sensors continue to receive values. No entries were deleted. Review automations and user settings before deciding which entities to retain through the HA UI.

migration_identity_invalid.title: Legacy account identity is invalid
migration_identity_invalid.description: Migration stopped because the legacy business identity is invalid. Existing configuration and sessions were preserved. Check the backup and confirm the account identity before retrying; do not merge accounts by vehicle nickname.

legacy_device_unmatched.title: Legacy device identity is unmatched
legacy_device_unmatched.description: An existing device identity is absent from the current account vehicle list. The vehicle may have been removed or use a different interface identity. Entities and history are preserved; no nickname-based merge was attempted. Check the backup and current identities before making changes through the HA UI.

session_recovery_pending.title: Session recovery needs a restart
session_recovery_pending.description: After a failed session update, HA could not unload the runtime using the replacement session. Its files were not replaced; the transaction journal and previous session backup remain. Back up HA configuration and restart HA to recover the previous session at startup. If recovery fails, retain the backup and check storage permissions; do not manually delete session directories.

model_storage_invalid.title: Battery parameter storage unavailable
model_storage_invalid.description: Cloud telemetry continues, but the optional battery parameter file is invalid or uses an unsupported version. The file has not been overwritten. Restore a compatible backup before changing parameters.

ride_event_storage_invalid.title: Ride event storage unavailable
ride_event_storage_invalid.description: The event cursor store is unreadable, incompatible or cannot be safely written. Event emission is suspended. Retain configuration/storage backups and check storage permissions and the integration version. Do not edit or delete the cursor file as a repair attempt. Other vehicle state and queries remain available.

travel_statistics_storage.title: Travel statistics storage unavailable
travel_statistics_storage.description: The private history statistics file is invalid or uses an unsupported version. It has not been overwritten. Current vehicle telemetry continues. Keep configuration backups and check storage permissions and the integration version before restoring a compatible backup.

entity_id_migration_conflict.title: Entity ID migration conflict
entity_id_migration_conflict.description: A canonical ID is occupied. Existing entities are preserved. Read entity migration results and review conflicting IDs and automation references; retain historical records.

entity_id_storage_invalid.title: Entity identity storage unavailable
entity_id_storage_invalid.description: Frozen identity seeds or migration records cannot be read. This account pauses setup to prevent duplicates. Restore a matching identity storage backup; do not edit registries directly.

ride_archive_capacity.title: Archive des trajets pleine
ride_archive_capacity.description: La limite de taille suspend les écritures. L’historique reste lisible. Sauvegardez toute la configuration et vérifiez la taille ; ne supprimez pas l’historique pour effacer cet avis.

ride_archive_io.title: Archive non inscriptible
ride_archive_io.description: Vérifiez espace libre et permissions, puis rechargez le compte. Conservez sauvegardes et fichier ; la télémétrie continue.

ride_archive_removal.title: Archive du compte supprimé conservée
ride_archive_removal.description: Fichiers inattendus, liens ou accès impossible empêchent le nettoyage. Sauvegardez et examinez le répertoire privé ; les autres comptes sont conservés.

ride_archive_invalid.title: Travel statistics storage unavailable
ride_archive_invalid.description: The private history statistics file is invalid or uses an unsupported version. It has not been overwritten. Current vehicle telemetry continues. Keep configuration backups and check storage permissions and the integration version before restoring a compatible backup.

ride_archive_object_corrupt.title: Certaines données locales ont échoué à la vérification
ride_archive_object_corrupt.description: Les autres données restent utilisables. Conservez les sauvegardes et vérifiez les objets concernés sans supprimer l’archive.

get_trips.name: Obtenir les trajets
get_trips.description: Query a vehicle month with local pagination. Cloud completeness is unknown. Detail requests require a limit of five or less.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: Select the vehicle device, not a battery component.

month.name: Month
month.description: Business month YYYYMM, for example 202609. Future months are rejected.

page.name: Page
page.description: Page within the rows returned by ninecli, not cloud pagination.

limit.name: Page size
limit.description: Maximum 100; maximum five when including details.

include_detail.name: Include details
include_detail.description: Read at most five trip details in this call.

include_track.name: Include track
include_track.description: Requires details and coordinates opt-in. Precise locations may persist in automation traces or response variables.

refresh.name: Refresh from cloud
refresh.description: Prefer the local archive by default. Enable to request a fresh cloud response.

get_trip_detail.name: Obtenir les détails du trajet
get_trip_detail.description: Query one trip verified in the selected vehicle and month. No history scan or vehicle control.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: Select the vehicle device, not a battery component.

ride_id.name: Ride ID
ride_id.description: Use the ride_id returned by Get trips for this vehicle and month.

query_month.name: Query month
query_month.description: YYYYMM; defaults to the current month in Asia/Shanghai. Specify it for older trips.

max_points.name: Point limit
max_points.description: Maximum 2000; defaults to 500. Also bounds speed samples.

include_track.name: Include track
include_track.description: Requires coordinates opt-in. Precise locations may persist in automation traces or response variables.

refresh.name: Refresh from cloud
refresh.description: Prefer the local archive by default. Enable to request a fresh cloud response.

point_offset.name: Source point offset
point_offset.description: Read a bounded chunk by original sequence; no coordinate or timestamp inference.

local_only.name: Read local archive only
local_only.description: Read saved detail without cloud fallback. Missing detail is reported; cannot be combined with cloud refresh.

get_history.name: Obtenir l’historique
get_history.description: Explicit batches of 3 months (max 6). Continuations last 15 minutes. Missing ride pages stay incomplete. Returns history, charts and scoped statistics; recorded month/ride facts are durable, while cursors and response indexes are memory-only. No automatic Recorder import.

get_statistics.name: Obtenir les statistiques de période
get_statistics.description: Return up to six months and their business-day statistics. Reads stored data by default; refresh uses the existing query cache. Missing data is not zero or proof of full history.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: Vehicle device belonging to a loaded account.

start_month.name: Start month
start_month.description: YYYYMM; at most six months per response.

end_month.name: End month
end_month.description: YYYYMM, no later than the current business month.

include_daily.name: Include daily statistics
include_daily.description: Keep missing days null; never distribute monthly energy across days.

refresh.name: Query upstream months
refresh.description: Explicitly query the selected months, reusing fresh cache; never fetch tracks.

import_statistics.name: Importer les statistiques historiques
import_statistics.description: Explicitly write valid closed day/month periods from the ledger to Recorder. Up to six months; no cloud request, hourly distribution or missing-data padding.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: Vehicle device belonging to a loaded account.

start_month.name: Start month
start_month.description: YYYYMM; at most six months per response.

end_month.name: End month
end_month.description: YYYYMM, no later than the current business month.

include_daily.name: Include daily statistics
include_daily.description: Also import verified daily statistics; disable to import closed months only.

get_entity_migration.name: Résultats de migration des entités
get_entity_migration.description: Read local old/new entity IDs and migration outcomes for this vehicle. Review automation and dashboard references.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: Select the vehicle device owned by this account.

sync_history.name: Synchroniser les trajets archivés
sync_history.description: Fill missing months by range, or use repair with 1–12 selected months. repair_status reads progress, repair_continue resumes, repair_cancel cancels. Partial lists remain partial. reconstruct lance une réparation locale avec un point de restauration privé ; reconstruct_continue/status/pause/cancel permet de reprendre, consulter, suspendre ou annuler. Aucun appel cloud ni commande au véhicule.

months.name: Repair months (YYYYMM list)
months.description: For sparse repair/cancellation; at most 12 distinct months per selection.

force.name: Analyser à nouveau les listes mensuelles

get_recorded_trips.name: Consulter les trajets enregistrés
get_recorded_trips.description: Lire uniquement l’historique local, sans requête cloud.

sort.name: Sort order
sort.description: asc: oldest first; desc: newest first. Keep the same order when continuing.
